title: Irreducible Characteristic Cycles for Orbit Closures of a Symmetric Subgroup
summary: Let $G = GL(n)$ and $K = GL(p) \times GL(q)$ with $p+q=n$, where the groups are taken over $\C$. In this paper we study a certain family of $K$-orbit closures on the flag variety $X$ of $G$. The geometry of these orbit closures plays a central role in the infinite-dimensional representation theory of the real Lie group $U(p,q)$, and has applications to degeneracy loci and combinatorics. In this paper we use small resolutions to study orbit closures in this family.
